description: A framework that registers routes by call rather than by decorator. The frontend enumerated zero entry points of an entire application, and a surface with no entry points reads exactly like a surface with nothing to say -- so everything inside those handlers was invisible. Three things had to exist together: the registration idiom, the request body read as a coroutine METHOD rather than as a property, and a call to an imported class method, which is how a data-access layer is written.

expected.note: two files from the handler, behind a class the caller imported. Three things had to exist together for this: the registration idiom, the body read as a coroutine method rather than as a property, and the imported class method resolving
a second framework making the decision Flask makes
